name: Shenzhen HeungKong Holding Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen HeungKong Holding Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and operation businesses in China. It operates through sales of residential properties, shops and office buildings; commercial and distribution operations; and others segments. It is also involved in property management; tourist development; wholesale and retail; and housing construction and municipal public works, integrates fire protection, electromechanical engineering, decoration, and foundation work. Shenzhen HeungKong Holding Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
